name: pr-closeout
description: PR closeout: ready reads a PR's merge readiness from GitHub as an exit-coded, fail-closed verdict (conflicts, unresolved review threads, failed or missing required checks, hidden merge gates, files the last review-branch round never saw, unarchived openspec changes); landed proves the merge afterwards (merged_at, head, merge commit on base, branch cleanup). A PreToolUse gate runs ready before gh pr merge, gh api …/merge and the GitHub MCP merge tool.
